section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of Study X, which included 490 women from the Portuguese general population. The mean age of participants was 24.76 years, and their mean BMI was 22.29. The majority of participants lived in an urban area.
section_summary.evidence_source: The sample of this study comprised 490 women from the Portuguese general population, with ages ranging from 18 to 55 years old (M = 24.76; SD = 7.66). The majority of participants lived in an urban area (72.9%) and 27.1% in a rural one. Body Mass Index (BMI) ranged between 15.24 and 42.24, with a mean of 22.29 (SD = 3.87)
